words.meaning: A force that makes something happen or happen faster.
words.example: The hackathon gave us the impetus to finish.
We'll rectify the error in the next version.

words.meaning: Found everywhere at the same time.

A benevolent senior shared all her old notes.
Bugs are inevitable; ship anyway and fix fast.

loop.meaning: The number of people someone has had sex with.
loop.example: Podcasts love asking guests about their body count.
loop.context: Common in dating-podcast debates; often used judgmentally.

loop.meaning: Having multiple romantic relationships at the same time with the knowledge and consent of everyone involved.
loop.example: They're polyamorous: both have other partners and everyone knows.
loop.context: Different from cheating: the key is consent and honesty. Often debated on podcasts.

loop.meaning: Friends with benefits: friends who have sex without being in a relationship.
loop.example: They said it was just FWB, but feelings happened.

loop.meaning: Two people each do better by betraying the other, but both end up worse than if they'd cooperated.
loop.example: Both shops slash prices and both lose money. Prisoner's dilemma.
loop.context: Explains trust, competition, cheating in relationships, arms races.

loop.meaning: When something occupies your thoughts constantly without you wanting it to.
loop.example: That cringe thing I said in 2019 lives in my head rent free.

loop.meaning: Delusional, usually about a crush or an unrealistic hope.
loop.example: She thinks the celebrity replied to her story because he likes her. Delulu.
loop.context: Teasing unrealistic expectations. 'Delulu is the solulu' jokingly means being delusional is the solution.

loop.meaning: Acting as if you're the protagonist of life and everyone else is a side character.
loop.example: Filming herself crying in public for content: main character syndrome.
loop.context: Calling out self-centred or performative behaviour.

loop.meaning: Sexually transmitted disease / infection, e.g. chlamydia, herpes, HIV.
loop.example: Getting tested for STIs is normal and responsible.
loop.context: Comes up in dating and health discussions.

india.text: India strongly condemned a Russian strike in the Black Sea that injured an Indian sailor and resulted in the deaths of two foreign nationals.
The INDIA bloc parties staged a protest march toward the Election Commission headquarters in New Delhi over the ongoing row involving the Chief Election Commissioner.
The Union Cabinet is set to consider a 10,000 crore rupee SME Growth Fund aimed at direct equity investments in small and medium enterprises.
Adani Power and Druk Green Power agreed to set up a 770 megawatt hydropower project in Bhutan, marking their second major collaboration.
The Bombay High Court noted that citizens face difficulties due to software constraints leading to voter deletions under the SIR process.
Telangana's poll chief ordered action against bulk Form 7 applications used to seek the deletion of eligible voters in parts of Hyderabad.
The Samajwadi Party dropped plans to field a third candidate in the Uttar Pradesh Rajya Sabha polls, allowing the BJP to win eight of ten seats.
SEBI is reportedly set to partially reverse its derivative settlement rules following extensive feedback and pushback from market participants.
The National Commission for Women proposed recommendations to introduce gender-neutral childcare leave and shared caregiving by parents in the private sector.

world.text: Flávio Bolsonaro is poised to win the Brazilian presidential election following a strong far-right surge in the first round.
The Parti Québéois won the Quebec election and revived plans to hold an independence referendum.
The UN Human Rights Council condemned attacks on civilians in Sudan and demanded an immediate ceasefire.
Pakistan, Turkey, and Saudi Arabia agreed to deploy rapid response forces to the Kingdom amid regional tensions.
The Pentagon confirmed the removal of B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford in England back to the United States.

onThisDay.text: Meghnad Saha was born, becoming a renowned Indian astrophysicist who formulated the thermal ionization equation critical to stellar physics.
Guru Har Rai died, having served as the seventh Sikh guru and preserved Sikh traditions during a politically turbulent era.
Vinod Khanna was born, growing up to become a legendary Indian actor, film producer, and prominent politician.
Egyptian president Anwar Sadat was assassinated during a military parade, fundamentally reshaping Middle Eastern geopolitics.
The Jazz Singer was released, revolutionizing the global entertainment industry as one of the first feature-length films with synchronized sound.
